information.description:
While not very tech-savvy, Snakecharmers fill a crucial role for the VDB: hitters that can put people down for good in meatspace. A good netrunner never counts on only the digital to get the job done, after all. Typically lead groups of Malfini and Spirits.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Voodoo Boys).
